title: He directs your steps

verses.text: A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD determines his steps.
The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD who takes delight in his journey.
I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go; I will give you counsel and watch over you.

caption:
You do not have to see the whole road to take today's step.

Making plans is not a lack of faith. You can hold them loosely, because the One who orders your steps takes delight in the journey. He promises to teach you the way and to keep watch over it.

Proverbs 16:9, Psalm 37:23, Psalm 32:8 (BSB)
